traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements in docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md are fully implemented and validated:
- Dual-position detection and fallback for CatchClause annotations are implemented in gatherBranchCommentText/gatherCatchClauseCommentText and verified by dedicated unit tests. - Before-catch annotations have priority when both positions exist, matching REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY. - Auto-fix for catch inserts annotations inside the catch body at the first statement, making the fix stable under Prettier (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX). - Real Prettier + ESLint CLI integration tests demonstrate that formatted code with various catch annotation patterns passes linting without manual intervention (REQ-PRETTIER-COMPATIBILITY). - The existing rule test suite, including catch and other branch types, still passes (No Regression). - Rule documentation has been updated to describe both valid catch annotation positions, precedence, and Prettier compatibility.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted unit tests, end-to-end integration tests, and updated documentation all passing and aligned with the story, this story is assessed as PASSED.
